# Architecture Checklist: ISK-0001 — Solution Dependency Boundaries & Build Conventions

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements for the module map, the refined project graph, plane separation, and contract versioning. This tests the requirements, not the code.
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every row of the `docs/03` Module boundaries table have exactly one stated home? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all `docs/03` illustrative ports and the request context placed, each with a named signature owner? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Does every production project in the refined graph have a stated list of approved direct references? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the edges that the `docs/03` "May depend on" column implies either present in the graph or explained? [Coverage, Spec §Overview, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the references each host must hold defined by role, explicitly replacing the baseline's "reference every project" rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Are projects of a kind the contract does not name, such as the `docs/04` maintenance worker, the ISK-0006 hosting sample, or benchmarks, addressed? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is a module's "one home" unambiguous where it spans an abstractions project and adapters? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the `<Provider>` and `<Adapter>` name patterns defined precisely enough to exclude `Abstractions` and multi-segment names? [Clarity, Contract §Approved direct references]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "reach" defined, including its starting point and how a project relates to itself? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Forbidden reach]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the module namespace rule say whether child namespaces and look-alike prefixes belong to a module? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK011 Are "control-plane projects" and "ingress projects" specific enough to measure? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the spec, the contract, and the data model state the same direct references? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK013 Is every forbidden reach in FR-011 free of conflict with an edge that FR-009 approves? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the spec's and the contract's module maps and port homes agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Is FR-030's "at least as strict" consistent with FR-012 removing the requirement that a host reference every project? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK016 Does FR-004 name the same revision triggers as the contract's "Changing this contract" section? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Is plane separation consistent with the `docs/04` embedded host that "may opt into control-plane services" and with the all-in-one developer container? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Versioning & Ownership

- [ ] CHK018 Is the supersession of version 1 stated, along with the rule that the old record stays unedited? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the revision process list everything a revision must update, including the paths that link to the current contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK020 Are accepted decisions, recommendations, assumptions, and post-MVP work kept apart, with a validator named for each assumption? [Traceability, Spec §Decision Classification]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the consequence of an empty module allow-list recorded, with the route for adding a real edge? [Assumption, Spec §TR-4, §AV-3]
- [ ] CHK022 Does each deferred `docs/03` expectation name the spec that takes it? [Traceability, Spec §FR-035]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
